facts.business: The company derives revenue primarily from rendering artificial intelligence solutions, software development services, technology consulting, and related support services to domestic and overseas customers.

auditor.name: M S P R & Co., Chartered Accountants, Hyderabad

key_risks: Revenue recognition requires management judgment in identification of performance obligations, determination of timing of transfer of control, estimation of stage of completion for fixed-price contracts, recognition of contract assets including unbilled revenue, and assessment of customer acceptance and project completion status.
facts.related_party_note: According to explanations given to us and based on our examination of records of the Company, transactions with related parties are in compliance with section 177 and 188 of the Act where applicable and details of such transactions have been disclosed in financial statements as required by the applicable accounting standards.
